ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface versus 15% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the trailing edges and terminal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central zone. Black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous, irregular-width band along the trailing edge. Distinct circular low-intensity clusters (mottling) are present, notably one mid-sized spot on the inner-right lobe and smaller punctate markings scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees with sharp convergence at the apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; the trailing edge exhibits a continuous jagged topography with irregular peaks and valleys, particularly pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory from the median notch, transitioning into an upward recurve at the distal tips, which are modified by secondary biological growth.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white and grey calcified clusters localized on the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Multiple small, circular orange-tinted surface depressions scattered across the white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several dark, unaligned linear pixel tracks; two distinct parallel marks on the right lobe and one prominent diagonal scratch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both fluke tips creating a bulbous, irregular terminal geometry. A singular dark, circular lesion is visible at the central base where the fluke meets the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme degree of calcified biological accumulation on the distal tips provides a unique, non-symmetrical silhouette to the outer fluke boundary.
